package.name: rover_safety_bridge
package.description:
The critical integration layer between ROS 2 and the deterministic safety supervisor in app.safety. The bridge is the only producer of /cmd_vel_authorized; it consumes /cmd_vel_requested and the bridged sensor topics, evaluates the supervisor, and publishes authorized motion plus structured safety state and event topics.
The deterministic runtime is authoritative; the bridge does not duplicate safety logic.
